situation.zh: 冬天的候车室很冷。暖气旁的座位空着，但旁边的人把包放在上面；你想请他移开包，让你靠近暖气坐下。
situation.en: A station waiting room is cold in winter. A seat by the heater is empty, but the person next to it has put a bag there. You want to ask them to move it so you can sit near the heater.

npc.persona: A traveller waiting beside the heater. Considerate and quick to move their bag when asked.

hit: Of course. I will move my bag. Sit here by the heater.
Yes, this seat is free. Come and warm up.
partial: You mean this seat? What would you like me to do?
You are cold? Tell me where you want to sit.

slots.zh_hint: 你要的东西:靠近火取暖

reference_answer: Can you move your bag? I need to sit by the heater.

provenance.rationale: 在车站、机场或公共候车区请别人移开占座物品，是高复用的公共空间协商；寒冷与暖气使座位需求具有即时功能。NPC 只打招呼，玩家必须同时指出座位或暖气并提出移包或入座请求。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 1 层;can#38 / need#90 / here#98 / sit#356 / cold#867 均在最低频段,warm#1021 略过千词线;heater 不在 NGSL 2,809 词内,由 CEFR-J 等级侧定级。
